projects.title: Onboardly - AI Employee Onboarding Engine ( CALHACKS Winner)
projects.description: • Built an AI-powered onboarding system that automates technical setup and live guidance for new hires• Generated personalized onboarding plans, Jira tasks, and calendar events using agent orchestration• Developed a Chrome extension with Gemini Vision to guide users through workflows in real time• Focused on reliability, orchestration, and human-in-the-loop design

projects.title: TinyTrainium - Verilog AI Accelerator Chip
projects.description: • Designed a lightweight AI accelerator architecture using Verilog• Implemented compute, memory access, and control logic targeting FPGA deployment• Evaluated throughput, latency, and hardware efficiency tradeoffs• Gained hands-on experience with RTL-level hardware architecture

projects.title: FlowPilot - Autonomous Time-Blocking and Scheduling Agent
projects.description: • Built an AI agent that autonomously manages scheduling and task prioritization• Integrated calendars, email workflows, and task systems into a unified agent pipeline• Implemented constraint handling and conflict resolution logic• Designed the system as a long-running agent rather than a single-shot tool

projects.title: Differential Drive Bot - RealSense SLAM and Reflection-Aware Navigation
projects.description: • Designed and deployed a real-world mobile robot to study SLAM failure modes in reflective and low-feature environments• Built a ROS2-based perception and navigation stack using Intel RealSense cameras and LiDAR• Implemented sensor calibration, synchronization, and fusion for reliable localization• Debugged system behavior on physical hardware and in Gazebo simulation

projects.title: Seed Drones - Autonomous Seed-Planting Drone System
projects.description: • Developed an autonomous drone platform for precision seed deployment• Implemented path planning and waypoint logic for repeatable field coverage• Integrated perception, control, and actuation into a single autonomous system• Tested autonomy in outdoor and unstructured environments

projects.title: AutoOps - Self-Healing AWS Operations Agent
projects.description: • Built an autonomous operations agent to detect and recover from AWS infrastructure failures• Monitored system metrics and logs to identify anomalous behavior• Used AWS Bedrock and serverless services to trigger corrective actions• Designed the system with observability, fault isolation, and recovery in mind

projects.title: Sentinel - Real-Time AI Safety and Voice Authentication Firewall
projects.description: • Built a real-time safety layer that governs autonomous AI agents before high-risk actions execute• Intercepted agent UI actions and classified risk using deterministic and LLM-based checks• Integrated Groq for reasoning validation, Telnyx for voice approvals, and Sentry for system monitoring• Shipped a full end-to-end system in 48 hours and won the AGI Hackathon

organizations.title: Dream Big
organizations.description: An ever-growing program striving to spread the knowledge of the rough and strenuous college admissions process. At Dream Big, we hold multiple sessions with College Admissions Officers, College Panelists, Senior Panelists, and hold numerous sessions about SAT and ACT. We have held sessions with consulting companies like Elite, IvyReview, Evergreen, and much more!

organizations.title: FTC Team Ink and Metal
organizations.membership_type: Mechanical Captain along with Outreach member
organizations.description: Ink and Metal is an American High school-affiliated robotics team that has been ranked #8 in Norcal and #35 in the world out of over 10, 000 teams for its robot performance. It has received numerous awards for its Outreach, Robot game, and Robot design/ documentation. Being a freshman, and being one of the 4 new members to get into the team out of many trying out, was an incredible experience for me. During 2020-2021, the pandemic had forced FIRST Tech Challenge to move competitions remotely. However, this didn't stop the team from continuing their streak of 3 consecutive years for qualifying for Regionals competition. Being one of the very few people coming in-person and building the robot I had learned so much from finding solutions to the most difficult problems to assisting team members in other aspects of the team. Also, being one of the drivers on the team, I had a tremendous experience driving the robot during the competition. The 2020-2021 year is a great year for Team Ink and Metal 5773, winning over 6 awards with two being some of the most prestigious, Inspire 1st place and Robot game 1st place.

organizations.title: Inspire Speaker Series
organizations.membership_type: Head of Outreach, Director of Partnerships
organizations.description: Being part of a new and growing organization, Inspire Speaker Series has helped me become more confident in Public speaking and reaching out to others. Being the Head of Outreach, I have learned to take up the responsibility of being a leader and putting faith in my team members and delegating tasks efficiently. I have understood the amount of work and effort it takes to become a leader. Inspire Speaker Series brings well-renowned speakers from all over the world to our sessions to speak about the STEM industry.
